Fetch the GLASS product overview table online

Source: R/glass_registry.R
get_glass_product_table.Rd

Scrapes the product overview table from glass.hku.hk with 'httr2'. On failure the bundled 25-product fallback table is used. In new code prefer glass_registry()/glass_product_info(), which also carry archive paths and band metadata.

Usage

get_glass_product_table(use_fallback = TRUE)

Arguments

use_fallback

Logical; if TRUE (default) return the bundled fallback table when the online scrape fails.

Value

A data frame of product overview rows, or NULL.
